rules.name: London reversal and New York continuation profiles use London to form the daily wick and New York to deliver the body
rules.setupAnchor: Track daily open plus London session range and mark whether London sweeps away from the daily open before New York opens
rules.confirmationTrigger: London creates the high or low of the day, confirms a CISD, and New York then continues from fair value gaps, order blocks, or sweep retests in the same direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The London shift that confirms the reversal creates the first intraday structural reference that New York continuation should respect
rules.invalidationCondition: London both reverses and fully expands before New York opens, or New York cannot hold the direction created by London's CISD
rules.targetLogic: Use London as the wick-formation session and New York as the expansion session, targeting continuation in the direction of the developing daily close
exceptions: If London already completes most of the day's range, New York continuation quality drops materially
machineChecks: Detect whether London forms the session extreme opposite the intended daily close
Require a London structure shift before enabling New York continuation logic
Block New York continuation setups when London has already completed the expected daily expansion
ambiguityNotes: The exact threshold for 'most of the day's range' still needs a first-pass numeric rule

rules.name: New York manipulation profiles sweep the current day's range during New York and then deliver in the opposite direction
rules.setupAnchor: London consolidates without completing the directional objective and New York approaches the London range high or low around 8:30 or 9:30 EST
rules.confirmationTrigger: New York sweeps the current day's range high or low, then closes through the opposing candle series to confirm the change in state of delivery
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The structural shift that forms after the New York sweep becomes the intraday reference that the manipulation profile must protect
rules.invalidationCondition: The sweep fails to produce a close through the opposing candles or price immediately retakes the swept side without directional follow-through
rules.targetLogic: Refine entries from the post-sweep order block or fair value gap and target previous-day highs, lows, or aligned liquidity pools in the delivered direction
exceptions: The profile is strongest when London consolidated instead of already forming a directional high-quality expansion
machineChecks: Detect whether New York sweeps beyond the active London range
Require a post-sweep close through the opposing candle series before entry eligibility
Track previous-day highs or lows as the first expansion targets after confirmation

rules.name: New York reversal profiles occur when London falls short of a higher-timeframe level and New York completes the run before reversing
rules.setupAnchor: Track a higher-timeframe level plus whether London failed to reach it while still leaning in that direction
rules.confirmationTrigger: New York extends into the missed higher-timeframe level, sweeps liquidity there, and confirms the shift with displacement plus CISD on a 15-minute or 5-minute chart
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The post-CISD swing created in New York becomes the structural invalidation for the reversal thesis
rules.invalidationCondition: New York reaches the level but cannot produce displacement and CISD, or the new swing fails immediately after confirmation
rules.targetLogic: Enter after confirmation beyond the CISD level and target failure swings, session highs or lows, or the nearest clean opposite-side liquidity pool
exceptions: If London already reached the higher-timeframe level, the setup should be treated as a different profile rather than a New York reversal
machineChecks: Require London to fail to reach the higher-timeframe anchor before New York reversal logic is enabled
Require New York to sweep into the anchor and then confirm with displacement plus CISD
Store the post-CISD swing as the active invalidation reference

rules.name: Seek and destroy profiles are rotational non-opportunity days unless false breakouts can be faded back toward equilibrium
rules.setupAnchor: Track Asia range plus whether London sweeps both sides without producing a sustained breakout
rules.confirmationTrigger: If London takes both Asia high and Asia low and New York mirrors the same range rotation, classify the day as seek and destroy rather than directional expansion
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: No directional protected swing should be treated as actionable while price keeps rotating across the range and returning toward equilibrium or the daily open
rules.invalidationCondition: Price stops rotating and instead confirms a clean directional escape with structure that holds outside the range
rules.targetLogic: Prefer standing aside; if traded at all, fade false breakouts back toward London equilibrium, daily open, or the middle of the active range
exceptions: Seek and destroy is more useful as a risk filter than as a mandatory mean-reversion setup
machineChecks: Detect whether London sweeps both sides of the Asia range without directional hold
Demote directional expectations when price keeps rotating back through London equilibrium or the daily open
Block expansion-style entries while no directional protected swing forms outside the range
